reviews.title: Nice Scent, light refreshing great value
reviews.body: I’ve been using Mrs. Meyer’s Clean Day Hand Soap in the Rain Water scent, and it’s quickly become a favorite. The fragrance is light, clean, and refreshing—not overpowering like some soaps can be. It leaves my hands feeling soft and clean without drying them out, even with frequent use.The formula lathers nicely, and I appreciate that it’s made with thoughtfully chosen ingredients. The bottle design is simple but attractive, so it looks nice on the sink too.My only minor complaint is that the scent doesn’t linger very long, but that may actually be a plus if you prefer something subtle. Overall, it’s a great everyday hand soap that I’d definitely buy again.
